name: codez-site
description: Publish new or throwaway web projects to Codez Sites for a quick preview or share link, and manage the site.

description_i18n.en: Publish new or throwaway web projects to Codez Sites for a quick preview or share link. The Sites panel shows your sites, deployments, logs and usage.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把新项目或临时项目发布成站点，快速得到预览或分享链接；在部署面板查看站点、部署记录、日志和用量。
